findings.message: Inbound ports are properly defined as independent use cases extending RefCounted
Application services properly extend inbound ports and provide concrete implementations
CreateProjectFromTemplatePort extended by CreateProjectService with proper domain entity creation
ApplyWorldEditCommandPort extended by ApplyWorldEditService with full CRUD operations
ApproveAIPatchPort extended by ApproveAIPatchService with parent-gated approval logic
CompileBlockLogicToRulesPort extended by CompileBlockLogicService with rule compilation
ManageDataLifecyclePort extended by ManageDataLifecycleService for COPPA/GDPR compliance
ManageEconomyPort extended by ManageEconomyService for parent economy management
RunPlaytestPort extended by RunPlaytestService for playtesting workflow
SetParentalControlsPort extended by SetParentalControlsService for safety policy management
Services are decoupled from Godot - no Node/Control/Spatial inheritance found
Services use outbound ports (ProjectStorePort, ClockPort, DomainEventBus, etc.) for framework-agnostic persistence and events
Services operate on domain entities (Project, World, SceneNode, WorldEditCommand) without Godot dependencies
Provenance tracking properly implemented with AI/HUMAN/HYBRID source types
Event sourcing with WorldEditedEvent emission for audit trail

acceptance_criteria.inbound_ports_exposed: PASS - All inbound ports defined as independent use cases in src/ports/inbound/
acceptance_criteria.use_case_implementations: PASS - Application services in src/application/ extend ports and provide implementations
acceptance_criteria.decoupled_from_godot: PASS - No Node/Control/Spatial inheritance in application services
acceptance_criteria.decoupled_from_network: PASS - Services use outbound ports for network operations
acceptance_criteria.decoupled_from_storage: PASS - Services use outbound ports (ProjectStorePort, etc.) for persistence

checklist.hexagonal_architecture: PASS - Ports define interfaces, services implement use cases, adapters call ports
checklist.test_coverage: PASS - Services are testable through their port interfaces

summary: APPROVE. TASK-002 implements a clean inbound port and application service architecture following hexagonal architecture principles. All inbound ports are properly defined as RefCounted classes, and corresponding application services provide concrete implementations that are fully decoupled from Godot, network, and storage adapters. Services properly use outbound ports for persistence and event emission.
